Article 15 of the GDPR gives a data subject the right to obtain from the controller confirmation whether their personal data are being processed and, where so, access to those personal data plus information such as the purposes of processing, categories of data, recipients, retention periods, and the source of the data. ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?qid=1494678401079&uri=CELEX%3A32016R0679&utm_source=openai))

It also entitles the data subject to obtain a copy of the personal data and information about any automated decision‑making, and requires the controller to provide the information without undue delay, subject to limited exemptions (for example to protect others’ rights). ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?qid=1494678401079&uri=CELEX%3A32016R0679&utm_source=openai))

Source link: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32016R0679
